The National Scholarship Programme of the Slovak Republic (NSP) is funded by the Ministry of Education, Research, Development and Youth of the Slovak Republic and administered by SAIA. It supports international master's students, PhD candidates, university teachers, researchers and artists for study and research stays at Slovak universities and research institutions. The monthly stipend ranges from €620 to €1,470 depending on the category, with extra contributions towards accommodation and travel.

Programme Highlights

  • Two application rounds a year: 31 October and 30 April, both at 16:00 CET
  • Monthly stipend from €620 (master's student) up to €1,470 (senior researcher/teacher)
  • Extra contributions towards accommodation and travel costs
  • Open to any nationality — the stay must be at a Slovak university or research institution

Who Should Apply

International master's students and PhD candidates planning a 2–10 month study or research stay in Slovakia, as well as university teachers, researchers and artists invited by a Slovak host institution. You need an acceptance or invitation letter from the Slovak host before applying.

Funding and Costs

The stipend covers living and mobility costs; it does not pay tuition fees, so confirm separately whether your host programme charges tuition. Accommodation and travel allowances are paid per the programme's current terms and conditions.

Deadline and How to Apply

Secure a host (invitation or acceptance letter) at a Slovak institution first, then submit the online application on the SAIA portal before 16:00 CET on the round deadline. Key deadline information: Round 1: 31 October 2026, 16:00 CET (summer-semester stays) · Round 2: 30 April 2027, 16:00 CET (winter-semester stays).

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About SAIA – Slovak Academic Information Agency

SAIA is the Slovak national agency that administers the National Scholarship Programme of the Slovak Republic on behalf of the Government of Slovakia, funding study and research stays of international students, PhD candidates, university teachers, researchers and artists at Slovak institutions.

Official website: https://www.scholarships.sk

Contact

Questions about this scholarship, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official scholarship page (see the Official Link section above). Always include your applicant ID or programme name so the admissions or scholarship team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements and deadlines on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form — transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
  • Deadlines shown in local time (CET/CEST) as published by the provider; convert to your own time zone before planning.
